summary: Iteration 10 — comprehensive URL/route smoke test on preview (https://aerox-wallet.preview.emergentagent.com). Verified 33/33 route + data-testid checks pass. Public routes (/, /login, /admin, /admin/login, /register, /change-password) render correct forms and enforce unauth redirects. Register flow with age+policy consent lands on Lobby. testuser login lands on Lobby. Admin login lands on /admin dashboard. Regular user creds at /admin/login correctly shows 'This account is not an admin' error and does NOT redirect. All 9 player routes render with expected data-testids (lobby-page, game-page, wallet-page, deposit-page, withdraw-page, leaderboard-page, referrals-page, support-page, profile-page) plus required child controls (contact-us-btn, refresh-txns-btn, refresh-upi-btn). All 8 admin routes render (admin-dashboard, admin-users, admin-deposits, admin-withdrawals, admin-upi, admin-support, admin-game, admin-reports) with required controls (refresh-users-btn, manual-credit-btn) and count headings ('Users (44)', 'Deposits (5)', 'Withdrawals (3)', 'Support tickets (5)'). Catch-all: /some-unknown-url as user → /. /admin/nonsense as admin → /. Logout returns to /login. Mobile bottom nav (375x812) — all 5 nav-* testids clickable and navigate correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: Hydration error: <button> nested inside <button>. UPI card wrapper is a <button> and contains an inner 'Copy UPI' <button type=button>. React logs: 'In HTML, <button> cannot be a descendant of <button>. This will cause a hydration error.' Fix: change outer element to a div with onClick+role='button' (keeping data-testid=upi-option-{id}), or move Copy UPI action outside the card.

integration_issues.issue: WebSocket connection to wss://<preview>/api/ws fails on every page ('WebSocket is closed before the connection is established.'). Non-blocking because polling covers state sync, but the failed WS should either be removed or the endpoint fixed to avoid noise + reconnection churn.

action_items: Fix nested <button> in /app/frontend/src/pages/Deposit.jsx line 99 (outer) + line 108 (inner Copy UPI). Convert outer to a <div role='button' tabIndex={0}> with onClick/onKeyDown, or lift the Copy UPI + QR actions out of the clickable UPI card so no button is nested. This triggers a React hydration warning on every visit to /deposit.
Investigate wss:///api/ws failure — either implement a working WS endpoint or remove the client-side WS connect attempt to reduce console noise.
critical_code_review_comments: Deposit.jsx: <button> nested inside <button> is invalid HTML and produces a React hydration error in production. Must be fixed.
Realtime WS: /api/ws is being connected from the client but the connection is closed before opening on the preview host. Either wire it up or gate the connect behind an env flag.
